description:
Make a gate evaluation resolve each direct dependency issue once per captured image when the issue lists a dependency more than once.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs` ~462: `captured_direct_dependency_issues` iterates the issue's `dependencies` as authored; a repository-authored issue with `dependencies: [B, B]` deserializes unchanged (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs` ~460), so evaluating its exec gate (~1251) decodes B twice from the same image. Capture-path deduplication does not cover this iteration.
- Story `d675102c` sol re-checkpoint r6 (commit `81804ff39`), finding 1 (low). Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): after six checkpoint rounds, further once-per-image instances are filed for v1.1 and recorded as a stated deviation on `d675102c` REQ-04.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A gate evaluation decodes each direct dependency issue once per captured image, including when the evaluated issue lists that dependency more than once.
- [hard] REQ-02: `test_gate_evaluation_resolves_its_inputs_once_per_captured_image` covers a duplicated dependency and fails on the parent commit.
title: A gate evaluation decodes a duplicated dependency once per captured image
